reproduction.source_template:
import CheckpointAllRustOracle
open CheckpointAllRustOracle
def events : List Event := <case.lean_input_events>
def signers : List (String × Nat) := <case.signer_ranks converted to Lean pairs>
def main : IO Unit := do
  for cut in List.range (events.length+1) do
    for upto in List.range (events.length-cut+1) do
      IO.println ((observations events signers cut (cut+upto)).compress)
